```{r,echo=FALSE}

directions = c("North","East","South","West")
d1 = sample(0:3,1)
turn = sample(c(-1,1),1)
d2 = (d1+turn)%%4
if(turn==-1){
    TD = "left"
} else {
    TD = "right"
}

D1 = directions[d1+1]
D2 = directions[d2+1]

sol = paste0(1*(0:3==d2),collapse="")

```

Question
========

A turtle is walking **`r D1`**. The turtle stops walking forward, and then turns 90° to their **`r TD`**. Which direction is the turtle now facing.


Answerlist
--------

* North
* East
* South
* West



Solution
========

After turning, the turtle is facing **`r D2`**.

============
